name: Cracked Brass Lens
description: Shows you things you are not ready to see. Cracks spider outward from the center like frozen lightning.

name: Sealed Fountain Water
description: Water that is not wet. Memory held in surface tension. Drinking it is not recommended.

name: Dull Iron Token
description: A token with no visible markings. It is warm to the touch, as if recently held by someone feverish.

name: Three Dry Matches
description: Ordinary matches that burn with a blue flame. The flame casts no shadow.

name: Sealed Scrap of Testimony
description: A fragment of someone's sworn statement. The seal is intact, but the paper inside is blank.

name: Violet Thread
description: Thread pulled from a drain near the fountain. It twitches occasionally, as if remembering being part of something larger.

name: Book of Backwards Names
description: A book from the market with pages that turn backwards. The names inside are arranged by date of un-birth.

name: Scratched Court Seal
description: A seal from the Drowned Court, scratched into fountain stone. It opens nothing physical.
